title: Motors, Induction and Domestic Circuits
summary: Force on a current in a magnetic field, Fleming's left-hand rule, the DC motor, induction and home wiring.

ib.note: Electromagnetism, MYP 5 Physics (motors and induction beyond the rationalised CBSE syllabus)

objectives: I can use Fleming's left-hand rule.
I can explain how a simple DC motor works.
I can describe domestic circuits and safety devices.
misconceptions: The force is along the field.
The neutral wire is always safe to touch.
